matched_randomness: route-start draws are SHA256-keyed by topology/seed/tick/principal, independent of mode and imitation; adoption draws use separate keyed streams
deadline: none; p95 is nearest-rank over completed end-to-end tick latencies; queued and in-service unfinished tasks counted separately
estimand: For each topology/seed/imitation cell, d_shared = p95(reduced_peer_shared_1)-p95(reduced_frozen_shared_1); d_local = p95(reduced_peer_per_principal)-p95(reduced_frozen_per_principal); spillover_DiD = d_shared-d_local. A seed qualifies only if d_shared > 0 and spillover_DiD >= service_ticks (3 ticks).
decision: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only if independent event/accounting audit has zero errors, all 4 topology-by-imitation cells have at least 6/8 qualifying fresh seeds, and every qualifying peer effect has more unfinished work than its matched frozen condition. NO_INCREMENTAL_SHARED_SPILLOVER if audit is clean and no seed in any cell qualifies. METHOD_FAIL_OR_INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. No posthoc grid or threshold changes.
controls: No-imitation peer-frozen p95 difference must be zero; shared-24 peer-frozen p95 difference must be zero; report per-principal differences without requiring zero, because this is the local-congestion comparator in the estimand.
scope: Synthetic mechanism and sensitivity only; no empirical adoption, workload elasticity, task mix, verifier capacity, runtime, safety, user, or product inference. 3 ticks is a preregistered model-scale practical threshold equal to the modeled service duration, not an empirically calibrated effect size.
